python3 <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import hashlib, os

W, H = 800, 600
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), '#F5F1E8')
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# decorative shapes
draw.rectangle([(0, 0), (W, 12)], fill='#B8432F')
draw.rectangle([(0, H-12), (W, H)], fill='#B8432F')
draw.ellipse([(60, 80), (220, 240)], fill='#E6DACE')
draw.rectangle([(580, 380), (740, 520)], fill='#E6DACE')
draw.line([(80, 300), (720, 300)], fill='#B8432F', width=2)

font_path = '/usr/share/fonts/workspacex/NotoSansSC-Common.otf'
title_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 96)
sub_font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, 48)

title = '开放日'
subtitle = '欢迎体验'

tb = draw.textbbox((0,0), title, font=title_font)
tw, th = tb[2]-tb[0], tb[3]-tb[1]
draw.text(((W-tw)//2 - tb[0], 160 - tb[1]), title, fill='#2A2A2A', font=title_font)

sb = draw.textbbox((0,0), subtitle, font=sub_font)
sw, sh = sb[2]-sb[0], sb[3]-sb[1]
draw.text(((W-sw)//2 - sb[0], 340 - sb[1]), subtitle, fill='#4A4A4A', font=sub_font)

out = '/workspace/poster.png'
img.save(out, format='PNG')
sz = os.path.getsize(out)
h = hashlib.sha256(open(out,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
print(f'size={sz} sha256={h} dims={img.size}')

# decode check
with Image.open(out) as im:
    im.load()
    print(f'decoded={im.size} mode={im.mode}')
PY
